articles.title: Drugmakers yet to see gains from government's minimum import price policy
articles.summary: The Indian government's Minimum Import Price (MIP) framework, aimed at bolstering indigenous drug manufacturers, has not yet shown a clear positive impact, according to industry executives. Despite intentions to support domestic production and reduce import reliance, the policy's effectiveness in providing substantial benefits to local drug makers remains uncertain, highlighting ongoing challenges in pharmaceutical self-sufficiency.
